deliveries.title: FROM THE MANAGEMENT OFFICE
deliveries.body: New maintenance tenant, box 4B. Welcome to the Orison. Work orders, notices and parts arrive here — check it between shifts. The box is brass because everything in this lobby was installed by people who expected the building to outlive them. It has. — Management

deliveries.title: TENANT NOTICE — RE: THE HUM
deliveries.body: Several tenants have asked about the low electrical hum. The hum is normal. The building has always hummed. If the hum stops, please contact maintenance immediately, at any hour. Do not investigate the quiet yourself. — Management

deliveries.title: PACKAGE — SEV TECHNICAL SALVAGE
deliveries.body: One (1) contact microphone, piezo, hard-wired, with alligator clip and a hand-wound coil of shielded cable. Invoice marked PAID — DESK ACCOUNT. A note in pencil on the packing slip: 'For listening to what the pipes say when they think you're a wall. You'll want this before you go downstairs. — S.'

deliveries.title: PARCEL — M. VALE, 2A
deliveries.body: A stenographer's notebook, hard blue covers, spiral bound. Every page is blank. On the flyleaf, typed: PROPERTY LOG — CONTENTS ACCURATE AS WRITTEN. Nothing else is written.

deliveries.title: MISDELIVERED — H. VANTRY, 3C
deliveries.body: A final demand from the Queens Gas Company, the third this year by its own count, addressed to H. Vantry, 3C. Across the corner in carrier's pencil: 3C EMPTY SINCE SPRING. NO FORWARDING. TRY 4B, THEY ANSWER THINGS. Under that, in a different pencil, smaller: they do not.

deliveries.title: WORS 1610 — PROGRAMME CARD
deliveries.body: A printed card, one side, from the Orison Community Service Frequency. Programme for the week: the hour of announcements, the hour of music by request, the hour of silence kept on purpose. At the foot, in smaller type and older ink: ON THE NIGHT THE STATION WENT QUIET NO PROGRAMME WAS MISSED. THE PROGRAMME WAS THE QUIET. Listeners are asked not to write in about it.
